# case: 28-env-zellij-attach-refusal
# desc: --env cannot be combined with --zellij --attach; rejected before any runtime argument is built
# config: docker-linux
--- exit ---
2
--- runtime-args ---
(empty)
--- stdout ---
(empty)
--- stderr ---
error: --env cannot be combined with --zellij --attach
       Attaching starts a Zellij client; the pane keeps the environment it was
       created with, so the variable would silently never reach the tool.
       Set it when the session is created instead.
--- filesystem ---
HOME dir 755
PROJ dir 755
